name: Rhun

attributes.attribute: hero in a tale of faithfulness
drugged the queen and took her finger
lost a horse race to Elphin

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Rhun is a Welsh hero. His name appears in a story of faithfulness and betrayal. King Elphin boasted that his own wife was more loyal than the wife of Rhun. Rhun went to Elphin and tried to charm the queen, but she refused him. He then drugged her and cut her ring finger. He carried the finger to Elphin, but the queen and her maidservant had changed places. Dough under the fingernail gave the truth away. Rhun later bet on whose horse was faster, and the bard Taliesin helped Elphin win the race.

okr.objective: Rhun is a Welsh hero who questioned honour.
key_results: He came to Elphin to test a woman.
